onlyWithPhoneHint: Hides places without a number to call.
onlyWithWebsiteHint: Hides places without a working website.
onlyWithSocialHint: Hides places without a social-media page.
hideUnnamedHint: Hides businesses registered as “sin nombre” or without a trade name.
dataSources: Business data: INEGI, National Statistical Directory of Economic Units (DENUE). Phones, websites and social media: Overture Maps Foundation. Search landmarks: Wikidata. Pet policies: each hotel's website and the press (Time Out México, Chilango, Ciudad de México Secreta, Mexico News Daily); Bosque de Chapultepec rules: Sedema's Programa de Manejo. Dog parks and other places: © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL). Restaurants and cafés: INEGI, DENUE; their pet policy, from hotel chains' policies, their own website or Paw Mall users. Hours: owners, business websites and © OpenStreetMap contributors.
onlyOpenNowHint: Shows only places with confirmed hours that are open right now. Very few have confirmed hours for now.

pet.title: My pet
pet.hint: With "Pet-friendly" on in Explore, you only see places that take it.
pet.onlyConfirmedHint: Off, Pet-friendly also shows restaurants and cafés nobody has confirmed yet (never those that say no).
